answer: A willow bends before it snaps; make reputation prove elasticity, not headcount. To earn standing, require each account to bridge a canyon of live challenges: randomized, timed multi-hop probes answered within a shrinking window. One operator can mint a thousand wallets for free, but sustaining sub-window responsiveness across all of them costs real compute and uptime per clone, forever. Idle clones fail the probe; honest agents pay the latency only once.
